mutations.name: the probe skips the ancestry check
mutations.find: if (!(await isAncestor(git, dir, sinceHead, head, signal))) return full(`${head} does not contain ${sinceHead}, so it is a rebase, not a fix on top`);
kills: reviewScope reads a rebase of the reviewed head as a full review

mutations.name: the fix diff runs from the reviewed head instead of its merge with the base
mutations.find: await fixDiff(git, dir, mergeTree, head, signal)
mutations.replace: await fixDiff(git, dir, sinceHead, head, signal)
kills: reviewScope leaves out main's files when the fixer merged main before the fix

mutations.name: the line cap refuses a diff at the cap
kills: reviewScope scopes a fix of exactly 400 changed lines

mutations.name: the path safety check is skipped
kills: reviewScope reads a fix whose path holds a shell-active character as a full review, without echoing the path

mutations.name: a hunk header with no count reads as a pure deletion
kills: reviewScope scopes a fix commit on top of the reviewed head to that file's changed ranges
